title: bug: routeUnlandedLanding (finalize_attempt 'unlanded', and since task-efe07ce5 the finalizing close) moves a REVIEW row parked for a human (needsHumanReview) to WORKING with the flag still set, so a worker can claim a row the qa_reject hard cap reserved for a human
description: qa_reject has no finalizing fence and accepts any seat or a workerId-less human on the unassigned REVIEW row during a landing (qaReject.ts:137-155). A hard-cap reject there parks it REVIEW + needsHumanReview. If the landing then ends unlanded (finalize 'unlanded', or a deregister/DEAD-record close with no completion recorded), routeUnlandedLanding (state/workerLifecycle.ts) sends it to WORKING without checking needsHumanReview. claimNextTask.ts:574/636 fence only REVIEW+needsHumanReview, so a worker can then claim it. Likely fix: leave such a row in REVIEW (set landingRetry only, or plain close) inside routeUnlandedLanding, plus a test for each route.
definitionOfDone: A daemon test fails on today's code: a REVIEW row with needsHumanReview true and a finalizing worktree attempt goes through finalize_attempt 'unlanded' and through moe.deregister_worker; in both cases it stays REVIEW, unassigned, with needsHumanReview kept, and no worker claim can take it.
finalizeAttempt.test.ts and state/finalizingCloseRetry.test.ts pass otherwise unchanged; docs/MCP_SERVER.md states the exception in moe.finalize_attempt and moe.deregister_worker.

implementationPlan.description:
Tests first (red). Create packages/moe-daemon/src/state/parkedUnlandedLanding.test.ts. Base it on /mnt/d/moe-scratch/7e735953-plan/proto-parkedUnlandedLanding.test.ts, which the architect proved red at 2a1c5a36 (5 failed, 1 passed). It reuses finalizingCloseRetry.test.ts's harness: ToolTestHarness, setupMoeFolder({ schemaVersion: 6 }), openAttempt with workspaceMode 'worktree' then setAttemptPhase 'finalizing', and the same three CLOSERS.
Seed: task-1 in REVIEW, unassigned, needsHumanReview true, reopenCount 5, all steps COMPLETED, with worker-1's worktree attempt finalizing. Also seed worker-2 and qa-1.
Cases:
(1) finalize_attempt 'unlanded' with reason 'conflict', and again with 'diverged' (which today goes BLOCKED). The reply has taskStatus 'REVIEW'.
(2) Each closer: moe.deregister_worker, the DEAD-record prune (deleteWorker) and the startup purge. The attempt ends 'closed'.
After every case assert all of:
- the task is { status:'REVIEW', assignedWorkerId:null, needsHumanReview:true, reopenCount:5 };
- landingRetry matches { reason, count:1 };
- claim_next_task { statuses:['WORKING'], workerId:'worker-2' } and { statuses:['REVIEW'], workerId:'qa-1' } do not return task-1;
- an explicit-taskId REVIEW claim by qa-1 rejects with /parked for human review/ (claimNextTask.ts:574).
(3) Control: the same seed without the flag is still routed to WORKING.
Record the red run in complete_step's note. Write the file with your own Edit/Write tool (global rail 3).

The fix (green). In packages/moe-daemon/src/state/workerLifecycle.ts, routeUnlandedLanding (:310 at 2a1c5a36; it came from efe07ce5's 3500ae19). Compute `const parked = task.status === 'REVIEW' && task.needsHumanReview === true;`. For a parked row:
- keep the status and the assignment: routing is {} exactly as for a non-REVIEW row, so it never goes to WORKING or BLOCKED and gets no blocked fields;
- STILL write landingRetry (count = prior + 1) and the one moe-daemon comment, with ', kept parked for human review (needsHumanReview)' appended. Then a human who later moves the row to WORKING hands the next worker a LANDING-RETRY with the rescue ref.
Update the function's docblock with one sentence for the exception. Leave every other path byte-identical: non-parked REVIEW to WORKING or BLOCKED (diverged, count >= 3), non-REVIEW unchanged, and retryUnrecordedLanding's guards. Both callers, finalizeAttempt.ts:153 and retryUnrecordedLanding, get the fix through this one function, so neither caller file changes. The prototype is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/7e735953-plan/proto-workerLifecycle.diff; apply it with your own Edit tool. Error handling is unchanged: it is a single updateTask write, and retryUnrecordedLanding's try/catch still keeps a failed write from failing the close.

Docs in docs/MCP_SERVER.md, two sections only, using your own Edit tool.
(a) `### moe.finalize_attempt`, the 'unlanded' **Routing.** sub-bullet (:641 at 2a1c5a36). Append: "A `REVIEW` task parked for a human (`needsHumanReview`, the `qa_reject` hard cap) also keeps its status and assignment, so no worker can claim it; it still gets the retry record and the comment."
(b) `### moe.deregister_worker`, the bullet 'A worktree landing with nothing recorded goes back for a retry.' (:2179). Add the same exception: such a row stays `REVIEW`, unassigned, flag kept, with `landingRetry` and the comment only.
Edit nothing else in the file. Other open rows own other sections: report_blocked is 31a2aa2f and 590b98bd, get_context is f0ca0ff0, release_task is 47652916. Re-grep each anchor first; if a peer moved it, edit the same sub-bullet wherever it now is.

Adversarial self-review of your own diff, run once (load adversarial-self-review). Check:
(1) Only routeUnlandedLanding changed in workerLifecycle.ts. Its non-parked paths are byte-identical: REVIEW to WORKING, BLOCKED on diverged or the 3rd landing, and non-REVIEW unchanged.
(2) A parked row gets no status, assignedWorkerId or blocked* fields in the update, but does get landingRetry and exactly one comment.
(3) `needsHumanReview === true` is a strict check, so an absent or false flag routes as before; the control case pins this.
(4) The reply's taskStatus reads 'REVIEW' for a parked row. The wrappers never branch on taskStatus (moe-agent.sh only acknowledges finalize), so nothing downstream breaks.
(5) Both doc sentences match the code.
(6) The diff is exactly 3 files, and finalizeAttempt.test.ts and finalizingCloseRetry.test.ts are untouched.
Fix anything you find. If any byte changed, re-run the step-4 checkRef and submit that fresh output.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: When a worktree landing ends unlanded, a REVIEW row that the qa_reject hard cap parked for a human (needsHumanReview true) stays REVIEW. It stays unassigned, keeps the flag and remains unclaimable by any worker or QA seat. This holds through both routes: finalize_attempt 'unlanded', and the finalizing close by deregister_worker, the DEAD-record prune or the startup purge. The landing-retry record and the moe-daemon comment are still written for whoever unparks it. Every other row routes exactly as today.
acceptanceCriteria: finalize_attempt 'unlanded' (conflict, and diverged) on a parked REVIEW row answers taskStatus 'REVIEW'. The task stays REVIEW, unassigned, with needsHumanReview true and reopenCount kept, and landingRetry.count is 1.
moe.deregister_worker, the DEAD-record prune and the startup purge each close the finalizing attempt and leave the parked row REVIEW, unassigned and flagged, with a 'contention' landingRetry.
After either route, a WORKING-pool or REVIEW-pool claim never returns the row, and an explicit-taskId claim is refused 'parked for human review'.
A REVIEW row without the flag still routes to WORKING, or BLOCKED on 'diverged' or the 3rd landing, and finalizeAttempt.test.ts and finalizingCloseRetry.test.ts pass unchanged.
invariants: A row with REVIEW + needsHumanReview is never moved by a landing outcome. Only a human path unparks it (release_task without a workerId, set_task_status, the board).
Non-parked routing (WORKING, BLOCKED for diverged or the 3rd landing, non-REVIEW unchanged) is byte-identical.
The diff is exactly workerLifecycle.ts, the new test file and the two MCP_SERVER.md sub-bullets.
compatibility: finalize_attempt's reply shape is unchanged. For a parked row, taskStatus reads 'REVIEW', and the wrappers never branch on it.
The LandingRetry shape and the comment format are unchanged apart from the appended parked note. Older rows and rows without the flag behave exactly as before.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: For a parked row, (a) still write landingRetry and the comment but keep REVIEW and the assignment, or (b) skip the routing entirely and leave a plain close. Chose (a). The human who unparks the row later then hands the next worker a LANDING-RETRY with the rescue ref; under (b) the unlanded bytes would have no record on the row. The root cause (qa_reject accepting a hard-cap reject during a landing window, qaReject.ts:137-155) is out of scope here, per the row's own fix direction.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: routeUnlandedLanding is the one routing definition for finalize 'unlanded' and for the finalizing close (deregister, the DEAD prune, the startup purge), added by efe07ce5 (3500ae19). finalizingCloseRetry.test.ts has a seed(over) helper and a CLOSERS map to copy. The claim fences for parked rows are at claimNextTask.ts:574 (explicit taskId) and :636 (pool).
